verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents official first-party SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, each with install and usage guides for scraping and brand data. Its llms.txt directs users to the official context.dev packages, replacing the deprecated Brand.dev names. A published OpenAPI spec further supports programmatic builds. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, evidence of SDK depth beyond quickstart (full endpoint coverage, typed models, versioning), SDKs for other languages.
